repository.scope: Only the listed nonlocal correction files belong to this audit; unrelated live-tree work is excluded.

mathematics.assertion_tested: The prior universal implication enclosed MOND mass => independent dark field and the claimed derivation retarded denominator => alpha_3=0 with no extra mode.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy algebra; positive radial AQUAL branch; finite two-time reciprocity model; standard scalar multiplier localization.
mathematics.conventions: AQUAL uses y=Phi'/a0>0. The localization principal term is U_dot lambda_dot after integration by parts.
inputs: standard local multiplier representation lambda Box U

bounds.theorem: Ordinary one-copy action with strict retarded inverse, and the standard finite multiplier localization

non_claims: No universal no-go for all nonlinear tensorial in-in constructions is claimed.
No PPN alpha parameter is assigned without a boosted 1PN metric solution.
The AQUAL counterexample is nonrelativistic and refutes only the enclosed-mass premise.
exact_results: The local AQUAL Euler equation has exterior flux r^2 mu Phi'=GM, so boundary data carry enclosed mass without an additional field.
A strict retarded kernel is nonsymmetric whereas an ordinary action Hessian and its inverse are symmetric.
The standard localization Hessian is [[0,1],[1,0]], with determinant -1, rank 2, no constraints, two configuration modes, and one negative kinetic direction in k=0 and k!=0 sectors.
A scalar response denominator alone lacks the boosted metric and gauge data required to compute alpha_3.

verification.test_status: The test program and main audit exited 0 on the final pre-commit tree.

checks: Differentiate the exponential AQUAL primitive and derive the radial Euler equation.
Evaluate shared-current and sourced-current ratio derivatives.
Compare Hessian reciprocity with a strict retarded kernel.
Calculate the localization Hessian, momenta, Hamiltonian, constraints, Poisson matrix, class count, and k sectors.
Audit whether the toy response supplies the data needed for alpha_3 and a gravitational DOF count.
result: The prior universal dark-field theorem and alpha_3 extraction are withdrawn. A narrower ordinary-action/strict-retardation/localization obstruction is established; the broad relativistic-MOND existence question remains OPEN.
residual_risks: Genuine closed-time-path variational constructions with nonlinear tensorial kernels are not classified.
A complete boosted 1PN solve is still required for preferred-frame PPN parameters.
